run_doctest_extract: run the doctest suite that validates Boost.Python extract functionality for bool, list, cstring, and custom types
test_extract_bool: test extracting boolean values from Python objects using the Boost.Python extract extension module
test_extract_list: test extracting Python lists from objects and verify type errors on non-list types
test_extract_cstring: test extracting C strings from Python strings and verify type errors on non-string types
test_extract_custom_types: test extracting custom X objects by value, pointer, and reference using Boost.Python extract
